summary: Phase 4 Settings (Roles, Users with mobile-login, Vehicle Brand/Model management, System Settings with toggles + integrations) tested end-to-end. Backend: 23/24 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_settings_roles_users.py. The single failure is a real masking bug in /api/system-settings/integrations/{name}: the field 'secret_key' is NOT masked because SECRET_KEYS predicate doesn't catch it (no 'secret_key' literal, doesn't end with '_secret' or '_token', and there is no 'starts-with secret_' check). Frontend: all critical Phase 4 flows pass — login label shows 'Email or Mobile', sidebar Settings group expands to 4 children, /settings/roles renders Administrator card with permission chips and creates new roles via dialog with all 4 perm-groups, /settings/users renders + new-user dialog rejects letters in mobile + saves successfully, /settings/vehicle-management creates brands/models with brand-card click → models view, /settings (System Settings) shows 4 tabs and toggle-whatsapp_enabled persists via save-toggles. One minor frontend testid bug fixed by me: child nav items ('Vehicle Management', 'System Settings') were rendering data-testid with a space ('nav-vehicle management') because line 103 of Layout.jsx didn't apply the same regex-replace that line 119 (top-level items) applies — fixed in place; verified all 4 child nav-* testids now resolve.

minor.issue: SECRET_KEYS={'api_key','api_secret','access_token','secret','password','smtp_password','webhook_secret'} + endsWith('_secret'|'_token') does NOT match the field name 'secret_key', so its value is returned in PLAINTEXT both on PUT response and on subsequent GET /system-settings. Verified with payload {api_key:'xyz123abcdef', secret_key:'sec_999_realvalue'} → response.fields.secret_key == 'sec_999_realvalue' (not masked). Fix: in _mask_integration, also match keys that start with 'secret' OR end with '_key' AND contain 'secret' OR add 'secret_key' to SECRET_KEYS. Recommended one-liner: change predicate to `k.lower() in SECRET_KEYS or k.lower().endswith(('_secret','_token','_key')) or k.lower().startswith('secret')` — but be careful not to mask innocuous '*_key' fields. Safer: add 'secret_key' to SECRET_KEYS and add startswith('secret_') check.

ui_bugs.issue: Child sidebar items used `data-testid={`nav-${c.label.toLowerCase()}`}` without the regex-replace, producing testids with spaces like 'nav-vehicle management' and 'nav-system settings'. Other selectors in the testid map ('nav-roles','nav-users') happened to work because they have no spaces. Fixed by mirroring the parent-item replace: `.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]+/g, '-')`. Verified all 4 testids now resolve.

(Optional, low-priority) Add <DialogDescription> to dialogs in Roles.jsx / Users.jsx / VehicleManagement.jsx / SystemSettings.jsx to remove the aria-describedby React warning.

rca of the issue: secret_key masking miss: _mask_integration iterates fields and masks if `k.lower() in SECRET_KEYS or k.lower().endswith('_secret') or k.lower().endswith('_token')`. SECRET_KEYS contains 'api_key' (literal) but not 'secret_key'. The field name 'secret_key' doesn't end with '_secret' (it ends with '_key') and doesn't end with '_token'. Result: tap.secret_key returns in plaintext on PUT response and on every subsequent GET. Reproduction: PUT /api/system-settings/integrations/tap {enabled:true, fields:{secret_key:'plain_secret_value'}} → response.fields.secret_key == 'plain_secret_value'. Mitigation: extend the predicate to include `or k.lower().startswith('secret') or k.lower() == 'secret_key'`. Also worth re-auditing all expected provider field names (Tap: api_key/secret_key/environment, MyFatoorah: api_key/api_token/environment, OTTU: merchant_id/api_key/secret, WhatsApp: phone_number_id/access_token, SMTP: host/port/username/password) to ensure every secret-bearing one is covered.
